description:
Turn down one pending application. The applicant is told, with your message if you give one.
Use for: saying no to one applicant. The reply says where the application now stands; get_application shows all of it.
Not for: ending a hire you already accepted (cancel_hire).
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: reject_application({"applicationId":"a3Vn8cQe1RuY6wHs","message":"Thanks, we chose someone closer to the shops."})
Repeat: Once this has worked, a repeat does not do it again while that result still stands: it is refused, or answers with what is already there.
Errors: application_not_pending; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

message.description: What the applicant reads with the rejection. Up to 1000 characters. Default: no message of yours; the applicant then reads a general sentence.

name: reject_application

actions.description: Tools you may call on this application now. Each tool still checks.

title: Reject an application
